comparison_name: 공통 다중 드론 탐색 파이프라인에서 관측 가치 함수 비교

gimbal_scan.model: common periodic lower/upper scan; physical pitch recorded each tick

motion.stop_rule: stop at first originally planned rest point whose complete future hover is jointly reservation-safe

candidates.route_prefilter: none; test every candidate; observed-free connectivity rejection only

communication: instantaneous shared observed map and planned trajectories
common_prior: staging free volume, building bounding volume, entry and anonymous target regions; no internal geometry or room labels
dynamics: kinematic exact tracking of FUEL Polynomial quintics; no downwash or attitude/controller dynamics
timing: synchronous simulation; component wall times logged separately; no real-time claim
entry_graph_update: before every assignment, same current map version for both policies
pending_utility_update: rescore active endpoints on the same current map, at most 4 additional predictions
